labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when PRs will be enabled for external contributors; this is contribution process, not a bug or docs error.

body:
Pull requests in this repository are currently limited to collaborators, so the next step is to describe the fix in an issue first, not to open a PR. Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for the process. A related earlier request about enabling PRs from forks is #4029. Questions about when PRs will open to external contributors are best raised in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
